archetypes.name: dyn-pre-fix-rebase
archetypes.rationale: Closed-PR pre-fix routing changes a Step 8 reship guard near conflict handoff precedence.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed pre-fix rebase routing around PR_CLOSED state. Check that the skip path still writes the proof sentinel through ship_pre_fix_rebase_main and does not bypass active rebase or conflict-handoff handling. Verify the reference prose matches the persisted state contract without changing route-exit semantics. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
